messages:
Front Desk: Heads-up — courier dropped off an oversized item labeled "UPRIGHT PIANO" in the lobby. It's currently sitting by the lower hotdesk row and blocking two smaller parcels.

deliveries-bot: UPS update — Pallet 3/3 delivered. Sig: Courier_TJ.

anya: @Front Desk can it be moved? I have an interview at 15:00 and the window hotdesk is booked for the candidate.

Front Desk: We don't have piano movers on-site. We can relocate the smaller packages to locker 7, but the piano will stay roped off until the movers arrive. Candidate can use Meeting Room B or the temporary "piano seat" if that's acceptable.

mike: I officially nominate the "piano seat" as our new company instrument. Will practice "Heart and Soul" at lunch :musical_keyboard: 

lucy: Also — Vendor Steve is due at 15:30 to inspect the instrument. Does he need a visitor badge?

Front Desk: Yes — tell him to check in at the kiosk and show ID. I'll prepare a temp badge "V:STEVE" (expires EOD).

sam: Heads-up: two personal packages were shoved under the piano. If one is yours reply with `CLAIM PKG <name>` and we'll move it to locker 12.

anya: CLAIM PKG anya

Front Desk: Got it — Anya's package moved to locker 12. I'll DM the combo. Please don't post locker codes publicly.

deliveries-bot: Movers ETA 16:05. If piano needs overnight storage submit a People Ops storage request: https://redwood.ops/requests/storage

lucy: Quick poll — where should the candidate sit? React :thumbsup: for MR B, :eyes: for piano seat, :hash: for the hotdesk (I'll tally)

mike: I'll take MR B — less chance of impromptu recitals :grin:

Front Desk: Candidate will be in Meeting Room B. Vendor Steve's badge ready by 15:25. We'll move remaining small parcels to the locker bank in 10m.
